theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_nipp_disjoint_packing
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (D : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (r : ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → c ≠ 0 → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (D i)) → (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (D i) (D j)) → (∀ i, D i ⊆ ball 0 r) → (∀ i, c ≤ μ (D i)) → False
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
